units.notes: I checked the newest state air permits for the Yaphank site. The Title V permit for the existing Caithness Long Island Energy Center, effective 2024, covers only the existing 346 MW combined cycle plant. No air permit for a second 750 MW plant or a data center has been filed that I could find. The Department of Energy request for information of April 2025 still describes it as a possible new 750 MW gas turbine plant for a Brookhaven Lab data center, aiming to start by the end of 2027. It names no turbine maker and no backup arrangement, so the equipment and Backup Power sources stay empty. GEM's capacity, status and fuel agree with the document. Latest Activity is April 2025, which matches the newest report I found. I found no EIA plant code, since the plant is not built.
